0022600217.text: The Wizards (4-7, 3-7 in their last ten, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Pacers (3-7, on a one-game losing streak) in Washington's 12th game of the season, with Washington 4th in the Southeast and 2.5 games back and 10th in the East. Washington is 2-5 on the road, while Indiana is 0-5 at home, and the Wizards are missing Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (out, foot), Reece Beekman (out, shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip, pinched nerve), with Bilal Coulibaly listed as day-to-day with a hand injury and a game-time decision. Indiana is without Ben Sheppard (out, knee), Johnny Furphy (out, knee surgery), and Tyrese Haliburton (out, hamstring strain), and the teams have not met yet this season, though Washington won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 131-118 win in Washington on February 20, 2026.
